parameters.name: AttackApp
parameters.description: A list of names of the attacked applications. Use the `["AttackApp1","AttackApp2"]` format.

parameters.name: AttackAppCategory
parameters.description: A list of categories of the attacked applications. Use the \["AttackAppCategory1","AttackAppCategory2"] format.

parameters.name: AttackType
parameters.description:
The type of the attack. Valid values:

- **1**: abnormal connection

- **2**: command execution

- **3**: brute-force attack

- **4**: scan

- **5**: other

- **6**: information leakage

- **7**: DoS attack

- **8**: overflow attack

- **9**: web attack

- **10**: backdoor trojan

- **11**: virus or worm

- **12**: mining behavior

- **13**: reverse shell

> If you do not set this parameter, events of all attack types are queried.

parameters.name: BuyVersion
parameters.description:
The edition of Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

- **2**: Premium Edition

- **3**: Enterprise Edition

- **4**: Ultimate Edition

- **10**: pay-as-you-go

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description:
The page number of the returned data.
Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: DataType
parameters.description:
The type of the risk event.
Set the value to **session**, which indicates intrusion prevention events.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description:
The traffic direction of the intrusion prevention event. Valid values:

- **in**: inbound

- **out**: outbound

> If you do not set this parameter, events in all traffic directions are queried.

parameters.name: DstIP
parameters.description: The destination IP address to query. If you set this parameter, only intrusion prevention events that contain the specified destination IP address are queried.

parameters.name: DstNetworkInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the destination VPC.

> This parameter is required only when \`FirewallType\` is set to \`VpcFirewall\`.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description: The name of the intrusion prevention event.

parameters.name: FirewallType
parameters.description:
The type of the firewall. Valid values:

- **VpcFirewall**: VPC firewall

- **InternetFirewall** (default): Internet firewall

parameters.name: IsOnlyPrivateAssoc
parameters.description: Specifies whether to query only the data that is traced to private IP addresses.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: NoLocation
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to query the IP address location information. Valid values:

- **true**: Does not query the IP geolocation information.

- **false** (default): Queries the IP geolocation information.

parameters.name: Order
parameters.description:
The sorting order. Valid values:

- **asc**: ascending

- **desc** (default): descending

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Default value: **6**. Maximum value: **10**.

parameters.name: RuleResult
parameters.description:
The handling status of Cloud Firewall. Valid values:

- **1**: Alert

- **2**: Block

> If you do not set this parameter, events in all handling statuses are queried.

parameters.name: RuleSource
parameters.description:
The source of the rule that is used to detect the intrusion prevention event. Valid values:

- **1**: basic protection

- **2**: virtual patching

- **4**: threat intelligence

> If you do not set this parameter, events detected based on all types of rules are queried.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description:
The field to use for sorting. Valid values:

- **VulLevel** (default): Sorts by risk level.

- **LastTime**: Sorts by the most recent occurrence time.

parameters.name: SrcIP
parameters.description: The source IP address to query. If you set this parameter, only intrusion prevention events that contain the specified source IP address are queried.

parameters.name: SrcNetworkInstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the source VPC.

> This parameter is required only when \`FirewallType\` is set to \`VpcFirewall\`.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: VulLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level of the intrusion prevention event. Valid values:

- **1**: low

- **2**: medium

- **3**: high

> If you do not set this parameter, events of all risk levels are queried.
